The isolated_runtime observations were recorded on openclaw 2026.7.1-2, not on the frozen pin 2026.6.6; contract 03 sec 2.1 requires the spike questions to be answered on the pinned SDK, so version-dependent verdicts are downgraded and the overall gate returns to FAIL until live evidence exists on 2026.6.6 (or the pin is bumped with justification). gate_rule: C2 Gate PASS requires every criterion deterministically satisfied ON THE PINNED SDK; any undetermined/partial/no keeps the gate FAIL and C2 stays NOT_SUPPORTED (C1 remains PASS). No time-proximity/tool-name/argument-similarity linkage guessing is permitted. Evidence recorded on a different runtime version does not count as pinned-version evidence.
